changes.summary: A December 2025 workshop trained about 650 government school teachers from Mangaluru and other Dakshina Kannada taluks in AI tools, organised with DIET Mangaluru. No district-wide ICT-training figures were found.

findings.claim: A five-day workshop on AI tools drew around 650 school teachers from Mangaluru, Puttur, Bantwal and other taluks, organised with DIET Mangaluru.
findings.quote: Around 650 school teachers from Mangaluru, Puttur, Bantwal, Beltangady, Moodbidri, and Sullia are participating in the workshop.
findings.title: SJEC hosts five-day workshop on 'AI for Teachers' for govt school headmasters

changes.summary: Officials link rising Muslim girls' dropout after Class 10 and PUC to the 2022 hijab controversy and scarce nearby girls-only options; new girls-only colleges are planned around Ullal. No district schooling statistics found.

findings.claim: Officials say dropout among Muslim girls after Class 10 and PUC rose after the 2022 hijab controversy, prompting new girls-only colleges in the Ullal area.
findings.quote: Officials cite the 2022 hijab controversy as a key turning point, leading to increased dropout rates among Muslim girls after Class 10 and PUC, particularly when nearby girls-only options are lacking.
findings.title: Girls-Only Colleges Gain Momentum in Mangaluru Amid Rising Community Demand

changes.summary: Reports from 2019 and 2023 show Udupi schools hit by summer water shortages, relying on campus wells that can dry up and on irregular municipal supply. No data on protected-well coverage was found.

findings.claim: A headmistress of an Udupi school said the well it relied on has dried up in summer, leaving it dependent on municipal water supplied twice a week.
findings.quote: We used to rely on a local well but it has dried up because of summer.
findings.title: Hit by severe water scarcity, Udupi schools seek time for reopening

findings.claim: Volakadu Government High School in Udupi said it was managing basic sanitation with water from campus wells during the May 2019 water crisis.
findings.quote: The school has been managing basic sanitation as the students are provided with water from the wells in the campus.
findings.title: Water scarcity forces schools in coastal Karnataka to postpone reopening

changes.summary: One July 2025 workshop in Udupi on digital literacy drew over 70 schoolteachers; the article does not say whether they teach in government schools. No government ICT-training coverage was found.

findings.claim: A digital-literacy and skill-development workshop in Udupi drew over 70 schoolteachers from across the district; the article does not say if they teach in government schools.
findings.quote: brought together over 70 schoolteachers from across the district to address the growing importance of integrating skill development and digital literacy into the school curriculum
findings.title: Udupi: Teachers Urged to Prioritize Skill Development in Students for Modern Age

changes.summary: A June 2024 Udayavani report says a Kumta school building stayed unrepaired through official negligence, with students taught in a health-centre room. Little other district coverage was found.

findings.claim: Udayavani reports that official negligence left a school building in Kumta unrepaired, with students being taught in a room of an Ayushman Arogya Mandir health centre.
findings.quote: Kumta ಅಧಿಕಾರಿಗಳ ನಿರ್ಲಕ್ಷ್ಯ: ದುರಸ್ತಿಯಾಗದ ಶಾಲಾ ಕಟ್ಟಡ ಆಯುಷ್ಮಾನ್‌ ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ಮಂದಿರದ ಕೊಠಡಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಪಾಠ
findings.title: Kumta ಅಧಿಕಾರಿಗಳ ನಿರ್ಲಕ್ಷ್ಯ: ದುರಸ್ತಿಯಾಗದ ಶಾಲಾ ಕಟ್ಟಡ

changes.summary: Udayavani reports cracked, collapse-prone government school buildings in Thirthahalli taluk (2025 and 2026), pointing to repair needs. Eight Shivamogga schools were also picked for PM SHRI upgrades that can include classrooms (2023).

findings.claim: Udayavani reports a 70-year-old government school building in Thirthahalli taluk with cracked walls, falling brick dust and fears of collapse.
findings.quote: ಸರ್ಕಾರಿ ಶಾಲೆ ಕಟ್ಟಡದಲ್ಲಿ ಬಿರುಕು; 70 ವರ್ಷ ಇತಿಹಾಸವಿದ್ದ ಶಾಲೆಗೆ ಕುಸಿತವಾಗುವ ಭೀತಿ
findings.title: ಸರ್ಕಾರಿ ಶಾಲೆ ಕಟ್ಟಡದಲ್ಲಿ ಬಿರುಕು; 70 ವರ್ಷ ಇತಿಹಾಸವಿದ್ದ ಶಾಲೆಗೆ ಕುಸಿತವಾಗುವ ಭೀತಿ

findings.claim: Udayavani reports the Temmemane government school in the Thirthahalli area is at risk of collapse, raising safety questions for its 30 students.
findings.quote: ಕುಸಿಯುವ ಭೀತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ತೆಮ್ಮೆಮನೆ ಸರ್ಕಾರಿ ಶಾಲೆ: 30 ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳ ಸುರಕ್ಷತೆ ಪ್ರಶ್ನಾರ್ಹ!
findings.title: ಕುಸಿಯುವ ಭೀತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ತೆಮ್ಮೆಮನೆ ಸರ್ಕಾರಿ ಶಾಲೆ: 30 ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳ ಸುರಕ್ಷತೆ ಪ್ರಶ್ನಾರ್ಹ!

findings.claim: Eight schools each in Shivamogga, Chikkamagaluru, Dakshina Kannada and Mysuru were selected for PM SHRI model-school upgrades, which can bring classrooms, laboratories, washrooms and a playground.
findings.quote: Eight schools each from DK, Shivamogga, Chikkamagaluru and Mysuru districts are selected for the project.
findings.title: 12 govt schools in DK, Udupi to be promoted under PM SHRI project

changes.factor: % Population Living in Households with Improved Sanitation

changes.summary: A 2023 report shows eight Chikkamagaluru schools were selected for PM SHRI model-school upgrades, which can include classrooms. No district reporting on classroom condition was found.

findings.claim: Eight schools each in Chikkamagaluru, Shivamogga, Dakshina Kannada and Mysuru were selected for PM SHRI upgrades; selected schools can get new classrooms, laboratories and library.
findings.quote: Eight schools each from DK, Shivamogga, Chikkamagaluru and Mysuru districts are selected for the project.
findings.title: 12 govt schools in DK, Udupi to be promoted under PM SHRI project

changes.factor: % Population Living in Households with Improved Sanitation

changes.summary: A 2023 report lists a playground among facilities the eight selected Chikkamagaluru schools can get under PM SHRI. No district reporting on playground gaps was found.

findings.claim: The same report on PM SHRI, which selected eight Chikkamagaluru schools, says chosen schools can get a library, laboratory, classrooms, washrooms, teaching staff and a playground.
findings.quote: The selected schools will have the opportunity to get a well-equipped library, laboratory, classrooms, washrooms, teaching staff, playground etc
findings.title: 12 govt schools in DK, Udupi to be promoted under PM SHRI project

changes.summary: NGO OSAAT documents a Virajpet-taluk school with a 95-year-old tiled building and 8 classrooms in poor condition; it built 4 new classrooms by 2022. No recent district-wide data was found.

findings.claim: OSAAT describes a Mayamudi school in Virajpet taluk with a 95-year-old tiled building and 8 classrooms in poor condition; it built 4 new classrooms, completed in 2022.
findings.quote: The school has a 95 year old Mangalore tiled building with 8 classrooms in poor condition.
findings.title: Mayamudi Karnataka - OSAAT

changes.factor: % Population Living in Households with Improved Sanitation

changes.summary: A September 2026 Deccan Chronicle report says a social-welfare residential school at Shantigrama in Hassan taluk ran in a shed, with a permanent building expected in about 6 months. No education-department classroom coverage was found.

findings.claim: A social-welfare residential school at Shantigrama in Hassan taluk was run in a shed; a new building there is being readied, expected to open in about 6 months.
findings.quote: A new building is getting ready at Shantigrama which is expected to be inaugurated in about 6-months.
findings.title: Karnataka: Residential School Shifted Against Wishes Of Students/Parents Temporarily In Hassan
